verdict.rationale: Cloning Git repositories is a fair question for a Unix-like terminal app on iOS, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions git, cloning, or support for HTTPS, SSH or the Git protocol. The listed commands (nslookup, whois, python3, lua, pdflatex, zip, ffmpeg) and the pkg install mechanism do not establish a git client.

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone Git repositories over HTTPS, SSH, or the Git protocol
